archetype: 1 (Organic & Earthy - Modified to TARE Brand Specs)
brand_principles: Measured Transparency - numbers/data highly visible, precise, minimalist, warm-neutral, sophisticated, not 'cold sci-fi' or 'clinical white'.

background.description: Bone - Primary background for the entire app

surface.description: Oat - Used for cards, panels, sidebars, and isolated surfaces

border.description: Stone for subtle dividers/tints, Clay for warm rules and structural borders

text.description: Ink for all primary text, secondary is a lighter derivation of Ink

accent.description: Beet - Single accent color for primary CTAs, active states, and highlights

status.description: Traffic-light system for badges/alerts ensuring WCAG AA contrast against Bone/Oat

layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Tailwind defaults (p-2, p-4, p-6, p-8) but applied generously. Cards should have minimum p-6 internal padding.
layout_and_spacing.mobile_first: Ensure all tap targets (buttons, list items) are at least 44x44px. Sidebar collapses on mobile into a hamburger menu.

cards.usage: Use for KPI widgets, machine status, user profiles, and form containers.

buttons.primary: bg-[#9E2B4E] text-[#F4EFE6] hover:bg-[#7A203B] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#B08866] text-[#241E18] hover:bg-[#C9BCA8] rounded-md px-6 py-3 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.field_ops_large: w-full py-4 text-lg font-bold min-h-[60px] flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md

tables.wrapper: overflow-x-auto w-full bg-[#E6DBC7] border border-[#C9BCA8] rounded-md
tables.header: bg-[#C9BCA8] text-[#241E18] font-semibold text-sm text-left py-3 px-4

badges.base: inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border

timeline_tracker.node_completed: absolute -left-[9px] w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-[#9E2B4E] border-2 border-[#E6DBC7]
timeline_tracker.node_pending: absolute -left-[9px] w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-[#C9BCA8] border-2 border-[#E6DBC7]

forms.input: w-full bg-[#F4EFE6] border border-[#B08866] rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-[#241E18] focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#9E2B4E]/50 focus:border-[#9E2B4E]
forms.label: block text-sm font-medium text-[#241E18] mb-1

icons.usage: Use crisp, minimalist icons. Avoid heavy filled icons; prefer stroke icons that match the Inter body font weight.

images.usage_rules: Minimal imagery. Focus on data. If user avatars or machine placeholders are needed, use the URLs below.

image_urls.description: Worker avatar placeholder for staff profiles

accessibility_and_motion.contrast: All text combinations provided (Ink on Bone, Ink on Oat, Bone on Beet) exceed WCAG AA 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility_and_motion.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='submit-btn').
accessibility_and_motion.motion: Keep animations functional. Fast hover states (150ms). Modals and sidebars slide in smoothly. No extravagant 3D or parallax.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts for Archivo, Inter, and Space Mono in the main HTML.
Configure Tailwind config with the custom colors: bone (#F4EFE6), oat (#E6DBC7), stone (#C9BCA8), clay (#B08866), ink (#241E18), beet (#9E2B4E).
Set background color of the body to Bone.
Implement the left sidebar for navigation, rendering role-specific items dynamically.
Build the Machine Control Center using the graphical ingredient level bars as described.
Ensure all numerical data, table cell numbers, and badge counts use the Space Mono font class.
Use Lucide-React icons for UI elements like QR scan (QrCode), camera (Camera), and table actions.
Ensure the layout is highly responsive. The app is heavily used by Field Ops on mobile, so make action buttons large and reachable.
